title: Vatican officially declares Easter Sunday bomb victims as Heroes of Faith
byline: The Vatican has officially declared the Easter Sunday bomb victims as Heroes of Faith, the Sri Lankan Catholic Church announced today.

title: Energy Ministry gets new Secretary
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has appointed G.M.R.D. Aponsu as the new Secretary to the Ministry of Energy.

title: Buddhist religious programme at White House prays for global peace
byline: A special Buddhist religious programme was held at the White House on April 16, amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, to invoke blessings for world peace and harmony among nations, as well as for US President Donald Trump and the American people.

title: Passenger held at BIA with Rs. 553,000 worth cigarettes, e-cigs
byline: A 25-year-old Sri Lankan businessman was arrested by airport customs officers in the early hours of April 18 while attempting to smuggle a stock of foreign-made cigarettes and electronic cigarettes valued at Rs. 553,000 through the “Green Channel” at the arrival terminal of Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA).

title: Woman assaulted, hair forcibly cut: Five arrested
byline: Five suspects, including the main suspect, have been taken into custody by Ragama Police in connection with the assault of a woman and the forcible cutting of her hair at a shop in the Ragama area.

title: US extends waiver allowing countries to buy Russian oil
byline: The US Treasury Department has extended a waiver to allow countries to buy sanctioned Russian oil and petroleum products at sea for about a month, as the Trump administration looks to boost oil supplies due to the global disruption caused by its war on Iran.

title: Meet the UCLA athlete bringing Bollywood dance to college gymnastics
byline: Tiana Sumanasekera walks onto the floor, face serious. She takes a knee and takes a breath, leans back and lifts one arm in the air.

title: Resignation of Energy Minister, secretary an eye wash: SJB
byline: The resignation of Power and Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody and the Ministry Secretary is an eye wash which is aimed at ereasing the coal purchase scam out of the people’s minds, an official statement from the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) said today.

title: Litro assures uninterrupted gas supply through May
byline: The Litro Gas Company says it is in a position to ensure a continuous supply of domestic gas throughout the month of May.

title: Trump says UFO review uncovered ’interesting’ documents
byline: President Donald Trump said on Friday that his administration’s review of UFO-related ​material uncovered a number of “interesting” documents, adding that an ‌initial tranche of records is expected to be released soon.

title: Afternoon showers expected in several provinces today
byline: Showers or thundershowers are expected to occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces, as well as in the Nuwara Eliya district after 1.00 p.m. today, according to the latest weather forecast issued at 5.30 a.m.

title: Several women assault incidents surface as police launch investigations.
byline: A video circulating on social media showing a woman being brutally assaulted in Moragahahena has sparked public concern, with police confirming that a suspect has been arrested.

title: 5.5 magnitude earthquake shakes Pakistan, Afghanistan
byline: Tremor felt across Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan’s capital Islamabad, parts of Afghanistan including Kabul, no Immediate damage reported

title: IRGC says Strait of Hormuz closed again over US blockade
byline: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) headquarters said Saturday that the Strait of Hormuz has returned to its previous state of “strict management” following what it described as Washington’s repeated breaches of commitments by continued blockade.

title: Pakistan’s diplomatic moment: A bridge of hope in turbulent times
byline: At a moment of sharpened geopolitical strain and deepening mistrust, Pakistan has stepped forward with striking diplomatic poise, emerging as a vital intermediary between the United States and Iran. In a climate where tensions risked spiraling further, Islamabad recognized—and decisively seized—a narrow yet pivotal window to foster dialogue between two long-standing adversaries.

title: Evening thundershowers expected from Monday
byline: Atmospheric conditions are expected to become favorable for evening thundershowers in most parts of the island from Monday (April 20), according to the latest weather forecast issued at 4.00 p.m. today (April 18).

title: NTC to deploy buses for New Year returnees to Colombo
byline: The National Transport Commission (NTC) says it will deploy additional buses to facilitate the return of passengers to Colombo following the New Year holiday period.

title: Two Indian-flagged vessels attacked by Iran gunboats In Hormuz, crew safe: Sources
byline: Two Indian-flagged vessels were fired at by Iranian gunboats in the Strait of Hormuz today, sources have said. No one was injured and the vessels were not damaged, they said. The two ships, however, had to turn back after the incident northeast of Oman in the shipping lane critical for oil trade.

title: Special traffic plan during Indian Vice President’s visit
byline: Significant traffic disruptions are expected in parts of Colombo and along key access routes as authorities implement a special traffic plan for the official visit of Indian Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan.

title: FMM raises concerns over journalist facing CID scrutiny on energy crisis article
byline: The Free Media Movement (FMM) has raised concerns after journalist Sulochana Ramaiyamohan reportedly came under scrutiny by Sri Lanka’s Criminal Investigation Department (CID) over an article related to the country’s ongoing energy crisis.

title: Iran tightens Hormuz control, Trump warns against ’blackmail’
byline: Iran said it was tightening control over the Strait ​of Hormuz on Saturday, warning mariners the vital energy route was again ​closed, but President Donald Trump said Tehran could not blackmail the United ⁠States by shutting the waterway.
